about: Every statement text the stored pictures' doors are judged on (6.27b round 4, Kevin Nov 18): both readers, sbd.rs and src/core/storage/driver.ts, must give each entry's verdict for each door (ordinary: sbd_tx and sbd_tx_raw; import: sbd_import_tx_raw). 'allowed' means the door reads the statement and goes on to check its values; 'refused' means the door refuses it whole; 'none' means it isn't about media_files or thumbnails. 'source' says where the text comes from: 'app' for one the app sends through a transaction, as it builds it (whitespace runs read as one space); 'query' for a read the app sends only through query or readBlob, never a door, listed so every text in src/ that names the tables is here; 'case' for a shape a test or review asked about. A Vitest (pictureStatements.test.ts) fails when src/ gains a text naming either table that isn't here, and the memory driver says so as a console error when a transaction carries one whose shape isn't.

statements.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO media_files (id, sha256, bytes, mime, width, height, byte_size, color_space, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO thumbnails (id, sha256, long_edge, bytes, mime, width, height, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO media_files (id, sha256, bytes, mime, width, height, byte_size, color_space, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'application/pdf', 0, 0, ?, '', ?, ?)
DELETE FROM thumbnails WHERE sha256 IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
DELETE FROM media_files WHERE sha256 IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

CREATE TABLE media_files ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, mime TEXT NOT NULL, width INTEGER NOT NULL, height INTEGER NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, color_space TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL ) STRICT

CREATE TABLE thumbnails ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_files (sha256), long_edge INTEGER NOT NULL, mime TEXT NOT NULL, width INTEGER NOT NULL, height INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, bytes BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE (sha256, long_edge) ) STRICT
SELECT mime FROM media_files WHERE sha256 = ?
SELECT bytes FROM media_files WHERE sha256 = ?
SELECT mime, long_edge FROM thumbnails WHERE sha256 = ? ORDER BY long_edge LIMIT 1
SELECT bytes FROM thumbnails WHERE sha256 = ? AND long_edge = ?

WITH gone(id) AS (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)), used(sha) AS ( SELECT json_extract(props, '$.file') FROM records WHERE type = 'media' AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM gone) UNION SELECT json_extract(before, '$.props.file') FROM ops WHERE json_extract(before, '$.type') = 'media' AND record_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM gone) UNION SELECT json_extract(after, '$.props.file') FROM ops WHERE json_extract(after, '$.type') = 'media' AND record_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM gone) ) SELECT f.sha256, ${} AS size FROM media_files f WHERE f.sha256 NOT IN (SELECT sha FROM used WHERE sha IS NOT NULL)
SELECT f.sha256, ${} AS size FROM media_files f WHERE f.sha256 NOT IN ( SELECT json_extract(props, '$.file') AS sha FROM records WHERE type = 'media' AND sha IS NOT NULL )
SELECT sha256 FROM media_files WHERE sha256 IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
SELECT width, height FROM media_files WHERE sha256 = ?
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES (?, ?)
WITH p(b) AS (SELECT ?) INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) SELECT 'b', b FROM p
INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES ('b', ?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES ('b', CAST(? AS BLOB))
INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES (?, ?) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO notes SELECT sha256 FROM media_files
ALTER TABLE media_files ADD COLUMN note TEXT
CREATE TABLE copied AS SELECT * FROM media_files
CREATE TRIGGER t AFTER INSERT ON records BEGIN UPDATE media_files SET bytes = NEW.id; END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX thumbs_by_sha ON thumbnails (sha256)
DELETE FROM notes; INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES ('x', ?)
INSERT INTO media_files (sha256, bytes) VALUES ('x', ?); DELETE FROM notes
CREATE INDEX i ON thumbnails (sha256); UPDATE thumbnails SET bytes = ?

INSERT INTO media_files -- a note
(sha256, bytes) VALUES (?, ?)
INSERT INTO media_files /* a note */ (sha256, bytes) VALUES (?, ?)
INSERT INTO notes (id, text) VALUES ('n1', 'see media_files')
UPDATE notes SET text = 'thumbnails' WHERE id = ?
UPDATE notes SET text = 'thumbnails, tidied' WHERE id = ?
DELETE FROM notes WHERE text = 'it''s in media_files'
UPDATE notes SET text = 'it''s' WHERE id IN (SELECT sha256 FROM media_files)
UPDATE "it's" SET x = 1 WHERE y IN (SELECT 1 FROM media_files)
